import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    
    inside = False
    best = 0
    words = 0
    length = 0
    i = 0
    
    while i < n:
        c = a[i]
        if c == '_':
            if inside and length != 0:
                words += 1
            else:
                if length > best:
                    best = length
            length = 0
        elif c == '(':
            inside = True
            if length > best:
                best = length
            length = 0
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            if length > 0:
                words += 1
            length = 0
        else:
            length += 1
        i += 1
    
    if length > best:
        best = length
    
    print(best, words)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
